cardOverview.overviewText: A youth-oriented First Swyp card offering cashback on online shopping, dining, and entertainment, with digital-first benefits.

benefitRows.name: District
benefitRows.offer: Get 25% off upto 100 while booking movie tickets on District.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the District app. Use promo code IDFCCCFM and pay with your IDFC First Swyp credit card to get 25% off on movie tickets up to ₹100, valid once per month. Contact IDFC FIRST Bank at 1860 267 3333 for assistance.

benefitRows.name: Lenskart
benefitRows.offer: Receive a complimentary Lenskart Gold membership upon successful payment of the joining fee.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, visit the Lenskart website or app and sign up or log in with your registered account. During checkout, apply your IDFC First Swyp credit card details to redeem exclusive offers or discounts. Enjoy priority access to eyewear collections and special deals.
